content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

The sovereign commerce infrastructure is a set of tools and technologies that allow digital creators to build and deploy their own online stores, without relying on third-party platforms. This approach matters because it gives creators full ownership and control over their businesses, enabling them to sell their products globally, without restrictions or fees. By using a combination of free and paid tools, creators can build a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of the sovereign commerce infrastructure is based on a combination of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments is used for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with a fee of only 0.5%. This architecture allows for seamless integration of all components, enabling creators to focus on building their businesses, rather than worrying about the technical details.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The sovereign commerce infrastructure is built for digital creators who are restricted from using conventional payment platforms, such as those in countries with limited access to financial services. It is also suitable for creators who want to maintain full ownership and control over their businesses, without relying on third-party platforms. By using this infrastructure, creators can sell their digital products globally, without restrictions or fees, and build a sustainable online business.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure enables creators to build and deploy their own online stores, without relying on third-party platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of the sovereign commerce infrastructure work together seamlessly, enabling creators to build and deploy their online stores quickly and easily. For example, GitHub Pages provides free hosting, while Cloudflare Workers enables backend logic and automation. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders and customer data, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver digital products instantly. NOWPayments integrates with the infrastructure, enabling automatic crypto payment verification and processing.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy the sovereign commerce infrastructure today, creators can start by choosing a hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. They can then set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and integrate with Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Finally, they can configure file delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and integrate with NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. With this infrastructure in place, creators can start selling their digital products globally, without restrictions or fees.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees is to use a sovereign commerce infrastructure, which enables creators to build and deploy their own online stores, without relying on third-party platforms. By using a combination of free and paid tools, creators can build a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. For example, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, resulting in a significant fee difference of $921 at 100 sales per month on a $97 product.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% on every sale, compared to Gumroad's 10% fee.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy the sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: choose a hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages; set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script; integrate with Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage; configure file delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2; integrate with NOWPayments for crypto payment processing; and test and deploy the infrastructure.
